title: Using Implementation Science to Adapt a Targeted Transportation Intervention for Patients With Diabetic Retinopathy (PRONTO-EYE)
official: Using Implementation Science to Adapt a Targeted Transportation Intervention for Patients With Diabetic Retinopathy (PRONTO-EYE)
summary: This is a a type 3 hybrid effectiveness-implementation pilot study to evaluate the PRONTO-EYE intervention, a rideshare transportation program, in patients with diabetic retinopathy with Medicaid insurance on adherence to ophthalmology visits.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Established patient
* Medicaid insurance
* History of diabetic retinopathy
* Lives within 25 miles of the clinic
* English speaking
